set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 6. Split pure FmriDataset scientific identity and query compilation from checked effectful OpenedDataset[F]. Add acquisition attachment, volume/surface domain adapters, dataset lowering to ResolvedResponseSelection, provenance and receipt propagation, ScalafimRuntime.openDataset, and explicit effectful model/fit/MVPA executor boundaries. Keep synchronous APIs only for synchronous or materialized sources, and use factual DatasetError.AdapterFailure values for cross-domain adapters. Acceptance: timing, geometry, topology, mask, ordering, calibration, and schema mismatches are typed; no implicit resampling occurs; segmentation and indexed-query behavior remain unchanged; FmriModel, FitPlan, and numerical kernels gain no F parameter; browser/async sources have no blocking facade; downstream gates pass; LatentResponseDatasetBackend is thin or gone. Stop if effects infect pure plans, browser reads block, or existing hierarchy semantics cannot be preserved.
